changelog: FIXED: "Item 1 has no name" on every order. The check added in 1.7.0 was reading the wrong field, so it complained about items that had a perfectly good name and refused to save. Nobody could take an order.
Designs are now accepted, not handed out. Unassigned design work sits on a shared board on My Jobs — press Accept and the job is yours from that moment.
Whoever accepts a job is the designer for it, whatever their job title, and that is what the design report counts.
Two people pressing Accept at the same instant can never both get it. The second one is told who got there first.
A job can be given back to the board while it is untouched. Once a proof has gone to the customer only a manager can move it.
Two separate monthly reports: User Performance now shows orders taken per person per month, and Designer Performance shows designs accepted per person per month.
